author: reek
body: The format-legal rows: filter the card rows by the format's legal uuids (empty format = no filter, whole pool). Template id i is row i of THIS list -- the templates and the deck gallery must both read from it, or a filtered pool shifts every gallery line onto the wrong card.

author: reek
body: Per-archetype pool depth for the current legal pool: how many creatures and modelled spells the archetype's color can draw on, and whether it is viable at all. Reported so the bridge never silently fields a dead deck.
